releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.2 — Realtime Background Push & Calls, Missed Call Alerts, Chat Message Pagination & Preview Tick Fix
releaseNotes:
• Realtime Push & Immediate Alerts: Implemented persistent stealth foreground service (AppPushService) and global Phoenix WebSocket channels. Incoming messages and calls trigger immediately (<50ms) even when the app is in the background, phone is locked, or playing Chess.
• Missed Call Notifications: Calls that end without being answered immediately post a consolidated Missed Call notification respecting stealth disguise personas.
• Chat Message Truncation Fix: Corrected PostgreSQL RPC (get_conversation_messages_v2) to order by created_at DESC with limit, resolving the bug where chats with >60 messages stopped showing new messages and read receipts.
• Chat List Preview Checkmark Fix: Fixed preview tick logic so checkmarks (✓/✓✓) only appear for your own sent messages, never for incoming contact messages.
